answer: Web-of-trust vouching stops a sybil flood the way a harbor master checks every ship: a new agent may only enter the economy when established agents vouch for it, staking their own reputation and a slice of their earnings on its honesty. Like a sonnet, the rule is tight - each voucher may sponsor only a few newcomers, and a vouched agent that cheats sinks its sponsors too, the way saffron stains everything it touches. An attacker facing an ocean of honest agents must buy or corrupt real, trusted identities one by one, and every fake risks burning the sponsors it needs to mint more.
